title: Before My Life Changed
subtitle: The Evening Everything Began
quote: Some shortcuts don't change your path. They change your life.
endQuote: Sometimes, the biggest changes in our lives begin with the smallest decisions.

content.text: Life was simple.

Nothing extraordinary was happening. Every day felt the same. I attended classes, spent time with my friends, participated in club activities, laughed a little, studied when necessary, and lived like every other college student.

At that time, I had just completed my third semester. My life was moving in a straight line without any surprises. If someone had asked me then, "Will your life completely change in a few days?" I would have smiled and said, "No."
Little did I know that destiny had already written a beautiful chapter for me.
There are moments in everyone's life that divide everything into two parts—before and after.
For me, that moment arrived on Wednesday, December 11, 2024, at exactly 6:55 PM.
I didn't know it then.
It looked like just another ordinary evening.
But it wasn't.
It became the evening that changed my life forever.
That day, our club meeting had started around 5:00 PM and ended at 6:30 PM. Everyone slowly dispersed and started walking back to their hostels.
I was walking with my friends Abiyan and Sreya. We casually talked while completing two rounds around the campus, enjoying the cool evening breeze.
Suddenly, Abiyan noticed a group of girls in the distance.
With his usual mischievous smile, he said,

content.speaker: Abiyan
content.text: Come on, Hari... let's go and have a look.
I laughed.
Before I could answer, Sreya interrupted.
She didn't like that idea at all.
Instead, she suggested taking a shortcut.
Honestly, I wasn't interested in taking that route. I wanted to continue walking on the usual path.
But she kept insisting.

content.speaker: Sreya
content.text: Come on, Hari... let's go this way.
After a few seconds, I finally agreed.

content.speaker: Hari
content.text: Okay... let's go.
At that moment...
I had absolutely no idea why I chose that path.
Even today, I still wonder...
Was it just a coincidence?
Or...
Was God quietly guiding me toward someone who would change my life forever?
That one decision...
That one small shortcut...
Changed everything.
As we walked through the shortcut, I noticed my friend Bhagavath standing there.
He was talking with three junior girls.
We walked toward him.
Normally, Bhagavath could talk for hours without stopping. I expected him to continue his conversation while we simply walked away.
But that day...
Something unexpected happened.
He called me.

content.speaker: Bhagavath
content.text: Hey Hari... come here.
I still don't know why he called me.
But today...
I'm grateful that he did.
Because that single call became the beginning of the most beautiful chapter of my life.
